extracted.intended_audience: Prospective Ford Foundation grant applicants (nonprofits, filmmakers, and local NYC organizations)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for prospective applicants about which Ford Foundation opportunities accept submissions, the foundation's funding priorities, and procedural rules (e.g., unsolicited proposals policy). Covers program-specific opportunities such as JustFilms and the NYC Good Neighbor Committee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with Ford Foundation's mission and programmatic work
rubrics_metrics.description: We invest in the individuals, ideas and institutions that address the underlying drivers of inequality and align with our programmatic work around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should address root causes of inequality and clearly show alignment with the Foundation's program areas and mission to expand people's power, participation, and equitable access to resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Most grants are foundation-identified; unsolicited proposals generally not accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: The majority of our grants are identified by the foundation and each program has its own strategy and comprehensive selection process. We do not accept unsolicited grant proposals by mail, email or phone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send unsolicited proposals via mail, email, or phone. Prospective applicants should look for specific, limited opportunities that explicitly invite submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Only limited opportunities accept submissions under specific conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Below are the limited opportunities that accept grant submissions under specific conditions. Further details can be found in the links below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must review each listed opportunity's page for eligibility, submission conditions, deadlines, and any program-specific requirements; only those explicitly open will accept applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: JustFilms — documentary film production grants (program-specific eligibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: Our filmmaking initiative under Creativity and Free Expression is accepts submissions for documentary film production grants. Submissions for documentary film production grants are currently closed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filmmakers should consult the JustFilms program page for detailed eligibility, submission windows, and application guidance. Note current closure of submissions; check for reopening dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: New York City Good Neighbor Committee — local organization eligibility and timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ford Foundation’s New York City Good Neighbor Committee accepts applications for grants from local organizations. Applications are currently closed and will open late Summer/early Fall 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only local (New York City) organizations are eligible for this committee's grants. Watch the Good Neighbor Committee page for the application opening and specific eligibility and selection criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program-specific strategies and comprehensive selection processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Each program has its own strategy and comprehensive selection process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect variation across programs in priorities, selection criteria, and processes; applicants should consult the specific program page for scoring criteria, priorities, timelines, and application instructions.
